messages.author: mohammad.muslim
messages.content:
Subject: Course Completion Status Discrepancy – 95.53% Instead of 100%

Dear ViBe Support Team,

I hope you are doing well.

I am writing to raise a concern regarding my course completion status on the ViBe platform.

Main Issue:

I have tried to watch the unmarked videos but the ViBe platform is restricting me from jumping to those unmarked videos, and it is practically not feasible or possible to rewatch all 1006 videos.

Although I have completed the entire course — including attending all lectures, watching all videos, attempting and completing all quizzes, and making notes throughout — my dashboard is still showing 95.53% completion instead of 100%.

Completion Details:

Total Completed: 961 / 1006
Videos Watched: 294 / 517
Quizzes Completed: 475 / 489
Section-wise Progress:

JavaScript: 2 sections, 79/90 completed
TypeScript: 12 sections, 211/288 completed
React: 19 sections, 253/369 completed
MongoDB: 9 sections, 118/125 completed
Express: 6 sections, 108/134 completed

messages.author: mohammad.muslim
messages.content:
Additional Notes:

I have already watched all videos up to the last lecture.But the count appears inconsistent, suggesting a backend progress-tracking issue.
During the course, I encountered multiple instances where the platform displayed a red message stating "progress not saved." After clicking "Continue," the system proceeded without updating the progress, indicating a potential backend flaw.
Manually rewatching hundreds of videos to identify unmarked ones is impractical. I have already spent 5–6 hours trying to resolve this, but the progress percentage remains unchanged.
I have tried to go back and rewatch the unmarked videos, but the platform shows a red alert: "Access Restricted: Returning to previous valid content." This restriction makes it impossible to rewatch specific videos, even if they are marked as incomplete.

Requests:
Please review my backend progress logs and manually verify my completion.
Update my course completion status to 100% after verification.
Ensure my Health Points (HPs) are not deducted due to this technical issue, as the incomplete status is not due to my lack of effort.
I have attached screenshots as proof of my current completion status and restriction to access previous unmarked videos.

I have carefully reviewed the FAQs and discussion threads, but my situation appears unique, as I’m unable to replay lectures which are  affecting the progress count.

I sincerely request your assistance in resolving this at the earliest, as I have fully completed the course and fulfilled all requirements.

Thank you for your time and support.

Regards,

Mohammad Muslim
